lint.notApplicableReason: No Python linter is pinned for the custom apps; the ADR-0001 boundary scan runs as part of `test`.

typecheck.notApplicableReason: The Frappe custom apps have no type-checking contract; Python syntax is checked by `build`.

smoke.notApplicableReason: Static contract (Chief, 2026-09-27): the runtime is a Frappe bench with MariaDB and Redis in the dev container (.devcontainer/), built from the upstream commits in bench-apps.lock.json, which the standalone verifier cannot start. `run` validates the Procfile and prints how to start the bench; Frappe unit tests run with `bench run-tests` inside the container (docs/testing.md).

externalDependencies.name: Python for the static checks (bench accepts >=3.10,<3.15)
Docker for the dev container runtime
MariaDB root password for the dev container
Upstream Frappe apps pinned by commit
